user.title: Connect to Claude.ai
user.description:
Enter your Claude.ai credentials. To monitor several accounts, add the integration once per account and give each one its own name.

**Tip:** Copy each account's session key from a separate browser profile or private window — logging out of an account invalidates its session key.

**Session Key:** Open DevTools (F12) → Application → Cookies → {claude_url} → copy the `sessionKey` cookie value.

**Organization ID:** In DevTools → Network tab, find any request to `/api/organizations/` and copy the UUID from the URL (e.g. `xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx`).

data.name: Name (e.g. Private or Work — used for the device and entity IDs)

reauth.description: Your Claude.ai session key has expired. Open DevTools (F12) → Application → Cookies → {claude_url} → copy the new `sessionKey` value.

Update your Session Key, Organization ID, or polling interval.

**Session Key:** Open DevTools (F12) → Application → Cookies → {claude_url} → copy the `sessionKey` cookie value.

**Organization ID:** In DevTools → Network tab, find any request to `/api/organizations/` and copy the UUID from the URL (e.g. `xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx`).
